title: ClientAction
description: A single client action frame. Each parameter is optional and omitted parameters retain their previous value. Body frame is right-handed: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up. Angular axes are X roll, Y pitch, Z yaw; client Euler rotations use radians in XYZ order.

linear.description: Body linear acceleration in g (9.81 m/s^2): X forward/backward [-3, 3], Y lateral [-1, 1], Z vertical [-5, 5].

angular.description: Angular acceleration in the range [-1, 1] for each axis. Units are in rad/s^2.
